Include all packing and allocation costs in timing; adopt only if the fixed gates pass.
risks: Changing tile order changes C traversal and B reuse, and may worsen cache behavior or interact with set conflicts. Results must come from fresh paired controls; historical scores are context only. Do not attribute any joint outcome to this proposal alone.
